findings.resolution: The file-only draft was rejected. R0.4c now materializes a separately pinned, typed Salesforce Change Evidence Graph from verified bytes; generated knowledge indexes remain developer-only discovery aids.

Package roots are derived from each side's exact sfdx-project.json. Runtime code and the dedicated source profile contain no application object, field, route, alias or demo literals; unsupported package source families fail closed.

Bounded no-follow reads and final replay bind exact base/candidate bytes. Producer, adapter, adapter contract, normalizer, ontology and source profile are content-pinned and current runtime contracts are independently rehashed.
File and owner receipts retain raw byte hashes while semantic element hashes exclude owner-byte changes. Formatting-only edits update evidence without fabricating semantic entity or relation changes.

Ambiguous lexical relations remain inferred, false permission entries emit no authorization edge, configuration values are digest-only, reserved attributes cannot override governed fields, and structural schema/identity ambiguity blocks output.
Artifacts remain ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible with incomplete source-family, upstream, seed, build, deployment, test, conflict, approval and global interlock gaps.
XML depth, element and output work are bounded after parse; streaming pre-parse enforcement remains a nonblocking peak-memory hardening item under the FOUNDATION acceptance boundary.
R0.4d must consume both graph sides with operation-aware seed semantics before change-seed completeness can be claimed.
